title: closure-drivenness
description: The condition that a predication settling v is generated by a closure operator: every successor step is the closure of the knowledge-join of the previous state with a new increment. Generated by applying a closure operator over the predication fiber algebra to drive a settling.

settling.description: the predication settling v = (v_tau) being driven

closure-operator.description: the per-fiber closure family cl = (cl_p) doing the driving

increment-sequence.description: the sequence (u_tau) of new evidence introduced at each step

closure-driven.description: whether the settling is closure-driven by the given closure operator

successor-step-law.description: v_{tau+1}(p) = cl_p( v_tau(p) \vee_k u_{tau+1}(p) ): each successor cell is the closure of the knowledge-order join of the previous state with the increment, cellwise in each predication fiber algebra
